raw_response:
I farm this land the same way I’ve learned over many years: don’t do fancy things, do what keeps the crop steady. On my 16.1 mu, I will still do wheat and maize one after the other. That is the safest for me. Wheat brings grain first, then maize follows right away, so I don’t leave the land empty. I have only two people at home, so I cannot make the work too complicated, and water from the well costs money, so I irrigate when the crop really needs it, not just for show. For fertilizer, I would rather not cut too much. If I save a little on fertilizer and the crop turns yellow, then I lose more at harvest. So I use the amount close to what has worked on my fields before, split into base and one topdressing. For maize after wheat, the time is tight, so I won’t do heavy tillage. I harvest wheat, clear the field fast, and plant maize right away.
